about: Changes Blizzard made after the item files were built, laid over data/items_forever_all.json and data/items_all.json when tools/build_items.py and tools/build_items_all.py run. One entry per item. 'set' replaces whole fields of the item record ('stats' replaces every stat, 'weapon' is merged). Give the date, the source and, where a number is worked out and not stated by Blizzard, say so in 'note'. Remove an entry once a rebuilt item file carries the change.

items.name: Rage of the Storm
items.note: Blizzard: 16 Strength (was 16 Intellect), weapon speed 3.6 (was 3.2). Our record had 12 Intellect and 15 Stamina from an older build; Stamina is kept as it was. The damage range is the old one scaled to the new speed at the same damage per second (35.7), not read from the client.
